text.en: 1. This Order is the Criminal Procedure Code (Prescribed Law Enforcement Agencies) Order 2025 and comes into operation on 1 September 2025.

2. The authorities specified in the Schedule and any officer of any of those authorities, authorised under any written law (other than section 40C of the Code) to investigate an offence, are prescribed as prescribed law enforcement agencies for the purposes of section 40C of the Code.

THE SCHEDULE
Paragraph 2
1.Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority
2.Central Manpower Base
3.Central Narcotics Bureau
4.Corrupt Practices Investigation Bureau
5.Gambling Regulatory Authority of Singapore
6.Health Sciences Authority
7.Housing and Development Board
8.Immigration & Checkpoints Authority
9.Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore
10.Land Transport Authority of Singapore
11.Ministry of Health (Health Regulation Group)
12.Ministry of Law (Anti‑Money Laundering/Countering the Financing of Terrorism Division)
13.Ministry of Law (Insolvency and Public Trustee’s Office)
14.Ministry of Manpower (Foreign Manpower Management Division)
15.Ministry of Manpower (Labour Relations and Workplaces Division)
16.Ministry of Manpower (Occupational Safety and Health Division)
17.Ministry of Social and Family Development
18.Monetary Authority of Singapore
19.National Environment Agency
20.National Parks Board
21.Singapore Civil Defence Force
22.Singapore Customs
23.Singapore Food Agency
24.Urban Redevelopment Authority
